title: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows…
description: phpMyFAQ versions from 4.2.0-alpha.2 up to but not including 4.2.0-RC.2 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows language-scoped editors to access translations beyond their authorized scope by exploiting a mismatch between the route language and the UI language parameter. Attackers can read sensitive information such as drafts, private notes, author emails, and revision data by manipulating the lang parameter in requests to the admin.faq.edit route.
